scope: Compact recorded measurements. All timed/gate/warmup records are retained for these four focused matrices; logs, absolute paths and large test inventories are omitted. Historical binaries are identified by fingerprints and are not distributed.

method.gatePolicy: All profiles execute full suite at <=100 tests; above that, fullGateProfiles execute full suite, remaining controls pass complete analysis-compilation + exact shared-fanout selection and native audit. Runtime workloads always assert execution.
method.ordering: serial fresh CLI processes; rotation advances every pair of rounds; odd rounds reverse the order (balanced for two-case controls)
method.cache: warm OS cache intended; related analysis disables persistent build cache; OS cache not flushed
method.timing: spawn through process exit including /usr/bin/time wrapper, startup, analysis, compilation, execution and JSON reporter output
method.memory: macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size, bytes; process rusage metric, NOT simultaneous aggregate process-tree RSS
method.sizes: generated synthetic commerce projects; not a measured private production application
